resources.string: Shows a small floating control over Exponential Idle. When you press Start it reads the Arrow Puzzle or 15-Puzzle minigame (from what Exponential Idle shows, plus a screenshot of the board for the arrows), solves it, and taps the tiles for you. It looks at which windows are on screen (where they are, not what they say) so it pauses whenever a call, dialog, notification shade or other app covers the puzzle, and resumes when it is clear.
